title: Network Intrusion Detection Adaptability under Spurious Labels: A Noise-Aware Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.21473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDSs) must incrementally adapt to emerging attacks, even when only a limited amount of labeled network traffic is available. Consequently, Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL)-based NIDSs have gained growing attention. However, existing FSCIL-based NIDSs are highly vulnerable to label noise in newly-observed attack classes. To address this limitation, we propose NAFN, a noise-aware FSCIL-based NIDS framework that reduces the impact of mislabeled data during incremental adaptation. NAFN consists of two components: (i) Noise Detection, which identifies and removes mislabeled biflows using noise-detection algorithms, and (ii) Feature Sampling, which estimates class-conditional embeddings from clean biflows, calibrates them with base-class statistics, and resamples synthetic features to recover the original biflow count. translated_title: 伪标签下网络入侵检测的适应性：一种噪声感知的少样本类增量学习框架
translated_abstract: 网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）必须增量式地适应新出现的攻击，即使在仅有少量带标签网络流量的情况下。因此，基于少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）的NIDS受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有的基于FSCIL的NIDS在面对新观察到的攻击类别中的标签噪声时极为脆弱。为解决这一局限，我们提出了NAFN，一种噪声感知的基于FSCIL的NIDS框架，能够在增量适应过程中减少错误标记数据的影响。NAFN由两个组件构成：（i）噪声检测，利用噪声检测算法识别并移除被错误标记的双向流（biflows）；（ii）特征采样，从干净的双向流中估计类条件嵌入，用基类统计数据进行校准，并重新采样合成特征以恢复原始的双向流数量。该框架遵循Rethink Few-Shot（RFS）师生范式……
tldr: 提出了一种噪声感知的少样本类增量学习框架NAFN，通过噪声检测与特征采样两个组件，有效降低新攻击类别中标签噪声对网络入侵检测系统增量适应性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NAFN, a noise-aware Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning framework for network intrusion detection that mitigates the impact of mislabeled data in new attack classes through noise detection and feature sampling components.
